gap: No result ChatGPT got states that under $600 a third added screen buys area and not pixels: three 1920×1200 panels total 6.91 MP, only 10% more than the 6.27 MP of two 2240×1400 panels, while the "2K" label on these pages covers anything from 3.11 MP to 4.10 MP per panel.
standout_why: Compared against the cited UPERFECT guide, the top-ranked Office Journal page and Dealectric's own two triple pages, all opened 2026-11-21. The UPERFECT guide gives no pixel density or megapixel figure and prints "2K" for both 2160×1440 and 2560×1600. The Office Journal lists only FHD Amazon listings, with no prices, pixel counts or port counts. Dealectric's pages already carry the inputs (6.27 MP for the Trio 3 Pro, 142 ppi and 345.2 sq in for the FOPO S788) but never set a three-screen model against a two-screen one. The cited Mobile Pixels page returned HTTP 429 on every try, so it was not compared. The finding is arithmetic on stated resolutions, not a measurement. The stronger normalisation for this angle (driver or native video for each three-screen model) could not be sourced, because the Aura, FOPO, INVZI and Mobile Pixels stores all returned 429.
decides: It confirms a two-added-screen 2240×1400 model as the pick for text work (Mobile Pixels Trio 3 Pro, linkable, $407.99 per the brief's 2026-11-21 read; UPERFECT BE14BF at $389.99 is a near-tie on pixels). It also reframes ChatGPT's "3 extra screens" branch: a three-screen 1920×1200 model wins on area (48% more at 14-inch, 93% more at 16-inch) and window count, but adds only 10% more pixels at about 142–162 ppi against 187 ppi. The FOPO S780C 14-inch ($499.99) and S788 16-inch ($540 through our link, per the brief) honestly win only the "most screen area under $600" segment. UPERFECT's own two pages disagree on whether the BE14BF needs a driver, so its "plug-and-play" row needs the caveat.
candidates: Aura Displays Triple Go Max 16 (specs not verified)

findings.label: Added pixels: three 1920×1200 screens against two 2240×1400 screens
findings.value: 6.91 MP against 6.27 MP, 10% more pixels from the third screen
findings.source_title: Best Triple Laptop Screen Extender (2026): Which Ones Run Both Screens on Your Laptop · Dealectric
findings.note: Resolutions as carried on Dealectric's page (Trio 3 Pro 2 × 2240×1400; FOPO S788 3 × 1920×1200). 2240×1400 = 3,136,000 px × 2 = 6,272,000. 1920×1200 = 2,304,000 px × 3 = 6,912,000. 6.912 ÷ 6.272 = 1.102. The maker pages returned HTTP 429 today, so the resolutions were not re-read at source.

findings.label: Added screen area: three-screen 1920×1200 models against the Trio 3 Pro
findings.value: 264.3 sq in (3 × 14-inch) and 345.2 sq in (3 × 16-inch) against 178.7 sq in (2 × 14.1-inch); 48% and 93% more area
findings.source_title: Best Triple Laptop Screen Extender (2026): Which Ones Run Both Screens on Your Laptop · Dealectric
findings.note: The page states 178.7 sq in (Trio 3 Pro) and 345.2 sq in (FOPO S788). The 14-inch figure is my arithmetic for a 16:10 panel: 11.87 × 7.42 in = 88.1 sq in × 3 = 264.3. 264.3 ÷ 178.7 = 1.48; 345.2 ÷ 178.7 = 1.93.
